receipts.settlement: EVERY token-producing job REJECTED with InvalidSignature. Root cause PROVED and reproduced on the live receipts (finding C10): the engine appends a 'stage' key AFTER signing; shard/verify.py (the settlement path) does not strip it, so the verify preimage != the signed preimage. One-line fix at shard/coordinate.py:343 (strip 'stage' at emit). Proved offline; NOT live-re-confirmed (ring destroyed before the retest).
